title.zh: Pika造出极速版MiniMax H3：生成步骤从50步压到6步，画质还更好
title.en: Pika造出极速版MiniMax H3：生成步骤从50步压到6步，画质还更好

current_state.zh: Pika released H3 Flex, a distilled version of MiniMax H3 that compresses video generation from 50 denoising steps to 6, ranks first among open-weights models on DesignArena's text-to-video leaderboard, and ships open adapted weights and inference code runnable locally via ComfyUI and Diffusers at up to 768p.
current_state.en: Pika released H3 Flex, a distilled version of MiniMax H3 that compresses video generation from 50 denoising steps to 6, ranks first among open-weights models on DesignArena's text-to-video leaderboard, and ships open adapted weights and inference code runnable locally via ComfyUI and Diffusers at up to 768p.
